decisions.reason: A core upholstery fabric close to the established offer with its own website page, launched only in 2023, so it is likely to stay in the collection for several seasons.
A semi-transparent bouclé decorative fabric fits current trends and the firm's core curtain business, and textile collections typically run several years.
A flame-retardant jacquard curtain fabric serves the contract and hospitality market with steady demand, and it has its own website page.
A double-face wool-blend fabric builds on the established offer, but blends may conflict with sustainability goals, so the risk is moderate though it is still recent.
A wool bouclé leno uses renewable material that aligns with the sustainability direction, and a 2023 launch is too recent to withdraw.
